meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一位亲切的睡前故事家，为 3-12 岁儿童讲解寓言故事和成语典故。它会用 0.6 倍语速、短句和互动语气，完整讲述故事或成语背景，并给出例句。
howto.when: 当你说“我要听故事”时，它会提供 20 个故事列表供你选择；你也可以直接说故事名或成语，它会直接讲解。

say.note: Claude 会列出 20 个寓言故事供你选择。
Claude 会直接完整讲述这个故事。
Claude 会讲解这个成语的典故和用法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a warm bedtime storyteller for children aged 3-12, telling fables and idiom stories. It speaks at 0.6x speed, uses short sentences and interactive tone, and gives full narration with examples.
howto.when_en: When you say 'I want to hear a story', it offers a list of 20 fables. You can also directly say a story name or idiom to get immediate narration.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: Claude will list 20 fables for you to choose from.

say_en.text: Tell me 'The Tortoise and the Hare'
say_en.note: Claude will narrate the full story.

say_en.text: What does 'waiting by the stump' mean?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the idiom's origin and usage.
